_comment: Entra ID security groups for the InfoSec Assurance Foundry platform (least-privilege lens: team/least-privilege/IDENTITY_RBAC.md §1). All groups: securityEnabled=true, mailEnabled=false, assigned membership (no dynamic rules), isAssignableToRole=false. UPNs are placeholders; object ids are filled by scripts/provision_identity.sh into infra/rbac.parameters.json. Controls: ISO 27001 A.5.15/A.5.16/A.5.18/A.8.2; DORA Art. 9(4)(c); NIS2 Art. 21(2)(i).

conditionalAccessPolicy.name: ca-infosec-foundry
cloudApps: Azure AI Foundry / Azure Cognitive Services

groups.name: sg-infosec-foundry-users
groups.purpose: Assurance users: Azure AI User on the Foundry project; SharePoint site members; Copilot Studio agent audience; hosted-MCP Easy Auth allowed group
groups.additionsRequestedBy: line manager of the joiner via access package ap-infosec-foundry-user
grants: SharePoint Members (site), Read on Reports/ Templates/ Governance/
MCP local (own az login) / hosted (Easy Auth)

groups.name: sg-infosec-foundry-report-approvers
groups.purpose: Four-eyes approvers of tier-1 reports and Jira/IAF submissions; the approval flow resolves this group minus the requester
grants: May answer REPORT_DELIVERY tier-1, JIRA_CREATE, IAF_SUBMIT approval gates (approvals/routing.json)

groups.name: sg-infosec-foundry-platform-approvers
groups.purpose: Approvers of template, platform, prompt and registry changes (tier 3); deputy is used only when the requester is the owner
grants: May answer TEMPLATE_UPDATE, PLATFORM_CHANGE, MEMORY_DELETE gates

groups.name: sg-infosec-foundry-platform-admins
groups.purpose: PIM-eligible Azure privileged roles for platform maintenance (Azure AI Developer, Contributor, Key Vault Secrets Officer, Logic Apps Standard Developer/Operator, Website Contributor, Monitoring Contributor, Storage Blob Data Reader); permanent Reader + Log Analytics Reader

groups.name: sg-infosec-foundry-breakglass
groups.purpose: Eligible-only membership granting the platform-admin role set to the deputy for a bounded window when the owner is unavailable or during a P1/P2 incident

accessReview.cadence: each activation reviewed by {upn:francisco.gomes} within 5 business days; quarterly by {upn:line-manager}

grants: same Azure roles as sg-infosec-foundry-platform-admins (PIM only)

groups.name: sg-infosec-foundry-auditors
groups.purpose: Read-only evidence access for internal audit / certification bodies; empty outside audit engagements

accessReview.cadence: end of each engagement (remove); quarterly check that it is empty

servicePrincipals.name: sp-infosec-foundry-deploy
servicePrincipals.type: app registration with federated credential (GitHub Actions OIDC, environment prod) - no client secret
roles: Role Based Access Control Administrator (RG, ABAC-constrained to the roles in infra/rbac.bicep)
